notes:
POC scope: deploy Redwood Private into TB EU VPC (eu-west-1) using company terraform modules + Redwood Helm charts. Primary goals: data residency (all data stays in customer VPC/S3, no egress), customer-managed KMS CMK for model keys, comprehensive audit trail (CloudTrail to S3, immutable retention), SSO via SAML, and performance validation for latency/throughput.

Recent activity:
- 2026-02-18 discovery call (ff_2026-02-18_1542): CTO Mark L. emphasized "no PII to hosted endpoints"; security team wants full KMS control.
- 2026-03-05 infra sync (ff_2026-03-05_1010): agreed Terraform varset and cross-account role pattern; Redwood to provide TF modules and Helm values sample.
- Sent pricing + private deployment runbook (drive links), awaiting GCC legal comments.

POC technical plan:
- Week 0: kickoff, exchange IAM role ARNs, KMS key creation plan, network CIDRs.
- Week 1-2: Terraform run in customer account (tf modules: redwood/vpc, redwood/iam, redwood/eks), Helm deploy redwood-inference release, RBAC + helm values for private CMK and audit endpoints.
- Week 3: Integration tests: KV cache behavior, batch/latency profiles, functional tests for chat and embeddings, SIEM forward verification.
- Week 4: Security validation: CloudTrail verification, S3 lock test, KMS key rotation policy check, SAML SSO end-to-end.
- Week 5: Performance soak (target 800-1k rps, p50 < 120ms for short chat payloads) + cost model review.
- Week 6: Sign-off meeting: security checklist complete, performance acceptance, legal SLA draft agreed.

Acceptance criteria for sign-off:
- All audit logs land in customer S3 with immutability policy and CloudTrail entries visible.
- KMS CMK used for all encryption in transit/at-rest for model artifacts and logs; CMK access limited to customer account and Redwood cross-account role.
- SAML SSO test users can authenticate and generate tokens via private endpoint.
- Throughput/latency thresholds met during soak (see perf targets above).
- Runbook and rollback documented; emergency fallback to Redwood-hosted routed only under explicit customer approval.
